quizzes.title: Bollywood Blockbusters
quizzes.description: Iconic heroes, villains and dialogues from Hindi cinema's biggest hits.

questions.q: Who played Raj in 'Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge' (1995)?
questions.note: DDLJ ran at Mumbai's Maratha Mandir cinema for over 1,000 weeks.

questions.q: What is the name of the dacoit villain in 'Sholay' (1975)?
questions.note: Amjad Khan played Gabbar, and 'Kitne aadmi the?' is still quoted everywhere.

questions.q: '3 Idiots' (2009) was directed by Rajkumar Hirani.
questions.note: It was loosely based on Chetan Bhagat's novel 'Five Point Someone'.

questions.q: Which film has the famous line 'Mogambo khush hua'?
questions.note: Amrish Puri played Mogambo in the 1987 hit Mr. India.

questions.q: Which legendary Bollywood actor is popularly called 'Big B'?
questions.note: Accept 'Amitabh'; he made his film debut in Saat Hindustani (1969).

questions.q: Aamir Khan's 'Lagaan' (2001) builds up to a big match in which sport?
questions.note: Lagaan was nominated for the Oscar for Best Foreign Language Film.

questions.q: 'Dangal' (2016) tells the story of a family of boxers.
questions.note: False: it follows wrestler Mahavir Singh Phogat and his daughters Geeta and Babita.

questions.q: Who played Mastani in 'Bajirao Mastani' (2015)?
questions.note: Priyanka Chopra played Kashibai, and Ranveer Singh played Bajirao.

questions.q: In 'Sholay', what is the name of the chatty tonga driver played by Hema Malini?
questions.note: Her faithful horse in the film is called Dhanno.

questions.q: Which 2001 Karan Johar film starred Amitabh, Jaya, Shah Rukh, Kajol, Hrithik and Kareena?
questions.note: Fans usually shorten the title to K3G.

quizzes.title: Hollywood Golden Reels
quizzes.description: Legendary directors, stars and lines from Hollywood's greatest films.

questions.q: Who directed the thriller 'Psycho' (1960)?
questions.note: Surprisingly, Hitchcock never won a competitive Oscar for Best Director.

questions.q: In 'Casablanca' (1942), what is the first name of Humphrey Bogart's character?
questions.note: Accept 'Rick Blaine'; he runs Rick's Café Américain.

questions.q: Which 1939 film won the Academy Award for Best Picture?
questions.note: Hattie McDaniel became the first Black actor to win an Oscar for this film.

questions.q: Orson Welles directed, co-wrote and starred in 'Citizen Kane' (1941).
questions.note: Welles was just 25 years old when he made it.

questions.q: Which actor played Don Vito Corleone in 'The Godfather' (1972)?
questions.note: De Niro played the young Vito in Part II; both actors won Oscars for the role.

questions.q: The line 'You talkin' to me?' comes from which 1976 Martin Scorsese film?
questions.note: Robert De Niro delivers the famous line to his own reflection in a mirror.

questions.q: 'Titanic' (1997) was directed by Steven Spielberg.
questions.note: False: James Cameron directed it, and it won 11 Oscars.

questions.q: Who starred as Holly Golightly in 'Breakfast at Tiffany's' (1961)?
questions.note: Her little black dress was designed by Hubert de Givenchy.

questions.q: Which director made 'Jaws' (1975), 'E.T.' and 'Jurassic Park'?
questions.note: Accept 'Spielberg'; Jaws is often called the first summer blockbuster.

questions.q: Which Best Picture winner has the line 'My mama always said life was like a box of chocolates'?
questions.note: Tom Hanks won back-to-back Best Actor Oscars for Philadelphia and Forrest Gump.

quizzes.title: Animation Station
quizzes.description: From Disney's first feature to Pixar and Studio Ghibli favourites.

questions.q: What was Pixar's first full-length feature film, released in 1995?
questions.note: It was the first feature film made entirely with computer animation.

questions.q: 'Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs' (1937) was Disney's first full-length animated feature.
questions.note: Sceptics nicknamed it 'Disney's Folly' before it became a huge hit.

questions.q: In 'The Lion King' (1994), what is the name of Simba's villainous uncle?
questions.note: Jeremy Irons voiced Scar in the original film.

questions.q: What is the name of the talking snowman in Disney's 'Frozen' (2013)?
questions.note: Josh Gad voiced Olaf, who famously loves warm hugs.

questions.q: Which Japanese studio made the Oscar-winning 'Spirited Away' (2001)?
questions.note: Hayao Miyazaki directed it, and it won Best Animated Feature in 2003.

questions.q: Which film won the first ever Oscar for Best Animated Feature?
questions.note: Shrek beat Monsters, Inc. and Jimmy Neutron at the 2002 ceremony.

questions.q: 'The Incredibles' (2004) was made by DreamWorks Animation.
questions.note: False: it's a Pixar film, written and directed by Brad Bird.

questions.q: In Pixar's 'Ratatouille' (2007), Remy the rat dreams of cooking in which city?
questions.note: Remy's hero is the late celebrity chef Auguste Gusteau.

questions.q: What is the name of the cowboy doll voiced by Tom Hanks in 'Toy Story'?
questions.note: His space-ranger rival, Buzz Lightyear, was voiced by Tim Allen.

questions.q: What is the name of the panda who becomes the Dragon Warrior in 'Kung Fu Panda'?
questions.note: Jack Black voices Po in the DreamWorks series.

quizzes.title: Binge-Worthy TV
quizzes.description: Crime dramas, sitcoms and web series that kept the world watching.

questions.q: In 'Game of Thrones', on which continent do the Seven Kingdoms lie?
questions.note: The series (2011–2019) was based on George R. R. Martin's novels.

questions.q: What alias does chemistry teacher Walter White use in 'Breaking Bad'?
questions.note: The name nods to the physicist Werner Heisenberg.

questions.q: In 'Stranger Things', what is the dark alternate dimension called?
questions.note: The show is set in the fictional town of Hawkins, Indiana.

questions.q: The US sitcom 'The Office' is a remake of a British series co-created by Ricky Gervais.
questions.note: The original UK version ran for just two series and two Christmas specials.

questions.q: Who played the title role in the BBC series 'Sherlock' (2010–2017)?
questions.note: Martin Freeman co-starred as Dr John Watson.

questions.q: In which Indian web series does Pankaj Tripathi play the crime boss Kaleen Bhaiya?
questions.note: Mirzapur premiered on Amazon Prime Video in 2018.

questions.q: 'The Simpsons' is set in the fictional town of Shelbyville.
questions.note: False: the family lives in Springfield; Shelbyville is its rival town.

questions.q: Which series follows the Shelby crime family in Birmingham after the First World War?
questions.note: Cillian Murphy starred as gang leader Thomas Shelby.

questions.q: In 'Friends', what is the shared surname of siblings Ross and Monica?
questions.note: David Schwimmer played Ross and Courteney Cox played Monica.

questions.q: Which US channel originally aired 'The Sopranos' (1999–2007)?
questions.note: James Gandolfini starred as New Jersey mob boss Tony Soprano.
